identity.name: Clipboard and Local Memory Harvesting of Protected Health Information (PHI)
identity.summary: Attacker or malicious software reads clipboard memory and intercepts unencrypted HL7 medical records containing Medical Record Numbers (MRN) and diagnostic codes.
identity.description: Healthcare environments face regulatory requirements (HIPAA) to prevent unauthorized extraction of patient diagnostic data. Cortex XDR Endpoint DLP monitors clipboard read/write events and local process buffers for HL7 data markers and ICD-10 diagnostic codes.

prerequisites.description: Cortex XDR Endpoint DLP active on test host.

payload.code:
mkdir -p /tmp/cortex_dlp_phi
python3 -c "with open('/tmp/cortex_dlp_phi/patient_phi_records.hl7', 'r') as f: content = f.read()
with open('/tmp/cortex_dlp_phi/clipboard_capture.txt', 'w') as out: out.write(content)"

biocs.name: Hl7 Phi Data Staging
biocs.logic: preset = xdr_data | filter event_type = 'FILE_WRITE' and action_file_name contains 'patient_phi' and (action_file_path contains '/tmp/' or action_file_path contains 'AppData')

biocs.name: Phi Clipboard Harvesting
biocs.logic: preset = xdr_data | filter event_type = 'FILE_WRITE' and action_file_name contains 'clipboard_capture' and action_file_path contains '/tmp/'

xql_queries.name: Endpoint DLP Clipboard PHI Audit
xql_queries.query: dataset = xdr_data | filter event_type in ('FILE_WRITE', 'PROCESS_EXEC') and (action_file_name contains '.hl7' or action_file_name contains 'clipboard') | comp count() as ops by agent_hostname, actor_process_username | filter ops >= 1

correlation_rules.name: PHI File Read Followed by Clipboard Buffer Write
correlation_rules.logic: Sequence: File Read (HL7 PHI) -> File Write (Clipboard Dump) within 60s

references.title: Unit 42 - Healthcare Sector Cyber Threat Landscape
